title: Bounded Continuous weak quasiregular mappings that fail to be quasiregular
summary: We show that, in dimensions $n\geq 3$, continuity and boundedness do not restore the Sobolev regularity conjecture of Iwaniec and Martin for weakly quasiregular mappings below the critical exponent. For every bounded domain $Ω\subset\mathbb R^n$ and every $1\leq p<nK/(K+1)$, we construct a bounded continuous weakly $K$-quasiregular mapping $$ f\in W^{1,\,p}(Ω;\,\mathbb R^n)\cap C(Ω;\,\mathbb R^n) \cap L^\infty(Ω;\mathbb R^n) $$ which fails to be quasiregular.
